main_text.p: זְבוּנָא Ch. Emptor, Esth.3.11. in Targ.sec.
וְכֶבְּן וְכִבְנָן Syr. Tempus. Idem quod זִמָן, ex commutatione litterarum homogenearum.
וְכִבְנָן In tempore, & non tempore, id est, Tempestive & Intempestive, 2.ad Tim.4.2.
זבר זְבוּרָא Ch. Apis. Hebr. דְּבוֹרָה commutatis ר & ז. Plur. זְבוּרִין, constr. זְבוּרֵי Levit.11.20. Jon. & foemin.
וְכַבְּנָן Syr. Ansa: Paropsis, patina, scutella, Matth. 23.25.26.
זב Ch.Nucleus, interius uvarum. Plur. עֲר זְגִין נְגִאִין דְּעָנְבָא Usque ad nucleos interiores uvae, Num.6.4. Jon.
זגא Idem quod סְגָא commutatis ס & ז, Deut.10. 22. in Jon.
זְגַתָּא Ch. Gallina, וְזִגְתָּא עַל אַפְרְחָהָא Et gallinam super pullos suos, id est, Pleiades, Hebr. עַיִשׁ Jobi 38.32. Sic Germani vocant die Gluckhennen.
זגא זְגָא Ch.Tintinnabulum. Plur. זְגִין, זְגִיא.
זְגוּנִיתָא Ch.Vitrum. Idem quod זְכוּכִית, ג & כ commutatis.

page.notes: Hebrew and Chaldee words are printed inline and are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised forms and the final entries at the foot are partly illegible and may contain errors. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
